verdict.rationale: LM Studio provides a documented REST API (OpenAI-compatible) for interacting with local models from apps/scripts, plus a CLI (lms) for scripting server start/stop, model loading, and chat, and a headless mode (llmster) for CI/server automation — all well documented in first-party docs and corroborated by community praise of the OpenAI-compatible server for programmatic use. missing for 10: independent third-party API reference docs beyond vendor blog/docs, and clearer coverage of API completeness/versioning stability.
